login.title: Sign in
login.lead: Sign in with the club Discord. There is no public signup.

nav.adminScheduleHint: Capacity, hour wash and grid rules

guild.lead: Server snapshot of the club Discord. Refresh reads the server and saves the list. The cabinet already uses those nicks.

empty.title: No snapshot yet
empty.lead: Press Refresh — the bot snapshots the server roster. The cabinet then uses those nicks.

not-live.title: No live database
not-live.lead: The server list is only available with Supabase keys.

unauthorized.title: Session expired
unauthorized.lead: Sign out and sign in with Discord again.

forbidden.title: No permission
forbidden.lead: Club admins and root can refresh the Discord snapshot.

root-only.title: Root only
root-only.lead: Only the owner can open this page.

not-configured.title: Bot is not connected yet
not-configured.lead: The list is read from Supabase secrets: DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN and DISCORD_GUILD_ID. Those are not the login Client ID or Client Secret. Add them in Edge Function Secrets, then refresh.

bot-not-in-guild.title: Bot is not on the server
bot-not-in-guild.lead: Invite the bot to the club server and let it see members.

members-intent.title: Discord will not share members
members-intent.lead: In the bot settings enable Privileged Gateway Intent: Server Members Intent.

bad-token.title: Token rejected
bad-token.lead: Copy a fresh token from the Bot tab and update the Supabase secret.

discord.title: Discord did not answer
discord.lead: Check the bot is on the server and the token is fresh, then refresh.

persist.title: Discord answered, the table did not update
persist.lead: Refresh again. If it repeats, write to us.

schedule.heatmapHint: GitHub-style grid · click to set YO
schedule.markHint: Letters and color come from the profile. Here you set tables and hours.
schedule.settingsHint: How to read the grid: the past, your clock, and the slot tooltip.
schedule.dimPastHint: Dims the past. Turn off to keep past as bright as the future.
schedule.hidePastDaysHint: Only today and the future stay on the month. Uncheck to bring the days back.
schedule.hidePastEmpty: Every day in this month has already passed. Uncheck “Hide past days” to see them again.
schedule.showLocalTimeHint: A second hour row, the header clock, and the slot card use your profile time zone. The grid stays CET.
schedule.showTablesHint: Show the table count on each chip.
schedule.showTipHint: A compact card with date, time, mark, Discord guild nick, and Winamax nick. No IDs. Click an occupied slot. While editing someone else’s mark, left click still opens it — or right-click if the club allows deleting others’ marks.

schedule.hoursStatLeftHint: Hours still left to play as of now

schedule.toastNoAccess: No access to this schedule. An admin grants it.

overwrite.replaceOff: The club does not currently allow replacing other people’s marks.

schedule.editPulseHint: The filter and hour header turn red while editing is on.
schedule.actAsWarn: This mark is placed for another player

schedule.slotLookHint: Tweak colors on the live grid. When you like it, copy the code and send it over.
schedule.washHint: Mark layer only. Veil goes to 100%. Toward paper darkens in dark theme and lightens in light theme.
schedule.playersEmpty: Nobody has this kind and limit in their cabinet yet.
schedule.donePlanHint: Later this will mark that this person finished planning. It does not work yet.

schedule.meStatHint: Per selected limit: hours this month and hours still left to play
schedule.noShifts: No shifts of yours on this day

wait.title: Waiting for approval
wait.lead: The admin has your profile. No schedule yet — nobody walks in from the street.
wait.leadDiscord: You are already on the Discord server. The schedule opens when an admin grants access.

cabinet.title: Cabinet
cabinet.lead: This is your card. Mark, permanent priority and type are set by an admin. The rest you edit by section.
cabinet.leadWait: Fill the blocks and save. Until an admin opens the schedule, there is no grid.
cabinet.noMember: There is no club card yet. Once an admin opens access, these fields can be filled in.
cabinet.clubLead: Discord and the mark come in automatically. Read-only here.
cabinet.discordAuto: Guild nick and avatar sync on sign-in. Not editable.
cabinet.discordIdHint: Discord’s id, not our club id.
cabinet.whoLead: This is an info block for admins. Everyone will see only the name.
cabinet.whoPrivacy: This is an info block for admins. Everyone will see only the name.
cabinet.notifyLead: Where the bot writes if your mark was removed, or later when it is your turn to fill the month.
cabinet.notifyAdminLead: Where the bot writes this person. You can change it here without asking them.
cabinet.notifyNeedTelegram: Add your Telegram in the profile above first. The bot can write there once the club connects it.
cabinet.notifyNeedEmail: Add your email in the login block below first. The bot can write there later.

notify.discordHint: A DM from the club bot
notify.discordNote: We write a Discord DM. This is the default channel.
notify.telegramNote: When the club connects a Telegram bot, send it /start — then messages go here.
notify.emailNote: Email comes next. Until then the bot still writes on Discord.

cabinet.namePublic: This is an info block for admins. Everyone will see only the name.
cabinet.headerTzHint: Your local time — so others know when they can reach you. Showing a second clock on the grid is a schedule setting.
cabinet.extraTzOn: Show my time on the grid
cabinet.extraUtcHint: Where you live by the clock. The grid stays CET. Turn on a second hour row in the schedule gear.
cabinet.loginLead: Three ways to sign in. Discord already works. You can link Google and email here.
cabinet.loginDiscordLead: Primary sign-in. You are already in.
cabinet.loginGoogleSoon: Google sign-in will be connected in the next step.
cabinet.loginMailLead: Fallback if you do not want Discord or Google.
cabinet.googleHint: We will use Google to sign in: fast, no password.
cabinet.emailHint: You can also sign in with email as a fallback.
cabinet.passwordHint: For people who want neither Google nor Discord: email and password only.
cabinet.gameLead: Pick the poker room at the top. On the left: Nitro and Regular with their own limits. On the right: nick and history for that room.
cabinet.roomKindsHint: Nitro and Regular are separate. You can leave both empty — then you do not show up in that kind’s player list.
cabinet.roomNickUpdate: Type the new nick here. After save it stays in the history below.
cabinet.payLead: USDT TRC20 and Skrill are already here. Fill in the address or account when you are ready. USDT is primary by default — you can switch. Add other methods below.
cabinet.payEmpty: No payout methods yet. Add a wallet or account.
cabinet.payNeedCard: Payout details appear once this person has a club card.
cabinet.payNameHint: Skrill EUR, a card, another wallet
cabinet.filterLead: Limits and tournament kind after sign-in. The month is always the current one — pick another in the schedule filters.
cabinet.filterNote: You can change the default limits and tournament kind here.
cabinet.joinedHint: When the Red Party card was created. Not the Discord server join date.
cabinet.priorityHint: Place in this kind’s fill list. 1 is first.
cabinet.discordServerHint: The club Discord server: nicks and roles come from there.
cabinet.discordRolesHint: Roles on the Discord server. Schedule permissions are set separately.
cabinet.assignedNickHint: Guild nick on the club server. Changing Discord does not create a new club person.
cabinet.guildNickHint: Nick on this club server. It can differ from the global Discord name.
cabinet.discordNameHint: Global Discord display name — the same on every server.
cabinet.discordIdHint: The account number Discord issues. We do not assign or change it.
cabinet.discordJoinedHint: When this person joined the club Discord server. Discord sends this date.
cabinet.clubCodeHint: Our short member code: RP- plus six characters. Not a Discord ID and not the database uuid. Support and admin search use it.
cabinet.loginDiscordOnly: Sign-in is Discord only. Email is so we can reach you.
cabinet.discordNeedSync: No server snapshot yet. Root refreshes it on the Server page.
cabinet.roomNickHint: The label used on slots for this room. History lives in the game block.
cabinet.communityHint: Training or RedParty is not a role and not schedule access.
cabinet.markHint: Optional. That chip is you on the field, if an admin sets one.
cabinet.name: Name
cabinet.contactAltHint: WhatsApp, Signal, a second phone — if Telegram is not an option.
cabinet.passLead: If you sign in with email, set the password here. Demo field.
cabinet.passwordOn: A password was set before. A new value overwrites it in the mock.

admin.title: Admin
admin.scheduleLead: Grid rules, slot capacity by CET hour and the pastel load wash. Pick tournament kind and limit first.

access.title: Access
access.lead: Which limits this person may mark on the grid. Separate from the limits they pick in the cabinet. Later this can follow Discord roles.

inbox.title: Waiting for access
inbox.lead: First Discord login creates a request. Approve to open the grid.

control.title: Schedule control
control.lead: Rules for the grid: other people’s marks, and tables. Off means the rule is not in use.
control.overwriteHint: A click on someone else’s mark removes it after a warning. Their own marks still clear with no prompt. Placing still needs an empty seat.
control.replaceHint: A drag over a range with other marks first removes them, then places yours. A click on someone else’s mark still only removes it. They get a notification.
control.tablesHint: When on, the edit dock sets a table count and it is stored on the mark. Off means tables are unused.

root.title: Root
root.lead: Developer only. Club bots, auto-notices, and who is a club admin. Regular admins do not see this.
root.discordLead: App name, bot id and server id.
root.tokenKeep: Leave empty to keep the current token
root.noticeChatPh: Discord channel ID, e.g. for the fill queue
root.autoLead: The toggle turns this bot’s mailing on. Off means the service stays quiet even if a person picked this channel in their cabinet.
root.autoMarkHint: If someone else’s mark is removed: the club channel gets whose mark, the slot and who removed it; DMs go to the owner and to the person who removed it.
root.autoQueueHint: When a person ticks “done”, the next one sees it in chat and in a DM. We do not run the queue yet — this is only the switch.
root.sendErr: Could not send. Check the token and the target.
root.botsLocal: Bot settings are stored in the live database.

discordBot.title: Discord bot
discordBot.lead: Three blocks: settings, mailing toggles, and a manual send. The token is never shown — only replaced.
discordBot.name: App / bot name
discordBot.configLead: Application and guild IDs. The token stays on the server and is not returned to the browser.
discordBot.sendLead: A Discord user or channel ID. For a person, the bot opens a DM.

telegramBot.title: Telegram bot
telegramBot.lead: A separate bot. The same three blocks: settings, notices, send.
telegramBot.name: Bot name
telegramBot.configLead: Username and the chat for public notices. The token can only be written, not read back.
telegramBot.sendLead: A person or group chat ID. The person must send /start to the bot first.

root.adminsLead: Member and administrator play. An admin is still a member, with extra rights. Staff accompany the club and do not play. Root is a service role, not a club seat.
root.roleAdminLead: Player with rights: capacity, people, inbox.
root.roleStaffLead: Support: organizers, tables, ops. Does not play.
root.roleRootLead: Deep service rights. In the club they are usually staff.
root.adminLocked: Root already sees admin. We do not take this role off them.
root.emptyPeople: Nobody yet. After a Discord login you can grant administrator here.

capacity.title: Capacity by CET hour
capacity.lead: Pick Nitro or Regular first, then a buy-in and a matrix: month 31×24 or week 7×24. Click to set depth, then save.
capacity.matrixHint: One hour is 2 slots. The number on the right is the day total. Cell color is depth.
capacity.conflictHint: If both limits are on and they overlap, the stricter one wins: the lower capacity in each hour.
capacity.previewLook: How these days look on the schedule. Light cells are open, hatch is closed.
capacity.needSelect: Select days in the grid first.
capacity.resetLimitHint: Restores the shared rule: day 1, night 2. A day has 64 slots: 48 in the row plus 16 at night.
capacity.resetSelectedHint: Selected days go back to day 1 and night 2.
capacity.halfHint: One hour is 2 slots, one row is 48. Night at capacity 2 adds 16 more, 64 in the day.
capacity.specialDay: Day {{day}} has its own capacity rule.
capacity.equalize: Apply maximum capacity to every day
capacity.equalizeHint: Every day is the same height. If Tuesday has no second level, the extra band is still there — empty, without the 50·2 label. The grid does not jump.
capacity.daysHint: Unmarked dates use the All days rule. Click a date for its own rule. You can select several dates at once.
capacity.maxHint: This many rows will appear for the limit in one day
capacity.editHint: Click to raise capacity, right-click to lower it. Click and drag to select a range of hours.
capacity.previewHint: Light cells are open half-hour slots. Hatch means the level is closed. One row is 48 slots.

load.title: Hourly load
load.lead: A pastel rainbow washed over the grid: almost invisible on one hour, readable across the strip. Each limit has its own wash.

people.title: Members
people.foldLead: Live list from the Discord server. Access is closed by default. An admin opens a member, admin, or staff — that creates the card.
people.lead: These are people from the Discord server, not a draft list. Members and admins play. Staff accompany and do not play. Root is a service role, last in the list, not a member.
people.guildLead: Bot snapshot. Status is ours, not a Discord role.
people.cardLead: The same layout as the cabinet. Admin-only fields are highlighted in green — the player does not see them.
people.loginLead: Same block as the cabinet. You can see the email and type a new password here if needed.
people.loginMailHint: You can edit the email. The password stays hidden.
people.resetSent: If this email exists on a login, a reset link will be sent.
people.discordReadOnly: Discord snapshot. Username, server nick, and roles are not edited here.
people.idsReadOnly: Permanent numbers. Neither the player nor an admin can change them.
people.roomEmpty: No room yet. Save limits and Winamax will appear.
people.tablesHint: Last table count in the edit dock. For the next marks, not ones already placed.
people.priorityHint: Fill-list order. Smaller number goes first. 0 means no priority.
people.noCard: No schedule card yet. Grant access and you can set a name, mark, and distance ID.
people.noSnapshot: No server snapshot yet. Root refreshes the list on the Server page.

needLive.title: Live Discord needed
needLive.lead: This list comes from the Discord server snapshot. Without a live database it stays empty.

people.rootLocked: Root cannot be closed from this list.
people.rootHint: Service rights. Club status is separate: staff if they do not play.
people.selfLocked: You cannot change your own status here.
people.distanceIdHint: Their number in the external hands service. Monthly dumps will match on this later. Not Discord and not the club code.
people.distanceIdDup: This ID is already used by another member.
people.colNitroHint: Which Nitro limits they may place on the schedule
people.colRegularHint: Which Regular limits they may place on the schedule
people.refreshHint: Pulls a fresh Discord roster into the database. This page loads from tables by default and does not call Discord until you press the button.
people.guarantorHint: Who brought this person into the club. Pick from members.
people.inviteLead: Fallback if they are not in Discord yet: email or nick and a profile link.
people.name: Name
people.empty: Nobody matches — clear the filter or change status.
people.vipHint: Empty means no priority. 1 is first in that kind’s list. The number is unique inside Nitro and separately inside Regular.
people.markHint: Chip color, letter color, then letters. Leave empty for no mark.
people.profileSoon: Wallets, Telegram and admin notes will land here later. For now: Discord ID, email, limits and VIP access.

marks.title: Marks
marks.lead: 200 colors in hue families, without washed-out yellows and oranges. Each swatch only offers high-contrast inks. Letters, Discord nick, and the pair “color family + ink” stay unique. The system does not reserve any letters, including PL.
marks.previewLead: Four slots as on the schedule. Sample marks show 12 tables.
marks.reserved: Until letters are set, the sample stays empty. Tables on the preview are always 12. Search: Discord nick, room nick in parentheses.
marks.dupNick: This Discord nick is already on another color
marks.dupCombo: A similar color already uses this type color

skin.label: Grid
skin.optHint: With edit on: click or drag empty slots to place, your marks to clear. Click someone else’s mark for who is there. If the club allows deleting others’ marks, left-click removes them after a warning and right-click shows the card. With edit off, a click shows the card.

tip.busyHint: You already have a mark this half-hour on another limit. You can still place here — hours still count that half once.
tip.lockedHint: This hour has capacity {{cap}}. Marks are allowed when capacity is at least {{need}}.
tip.markTables: Left click adds tables, right click removes them. The current number is saved on the slot and does not change later.

foot.title: Fill by CET
foot.lead: Each bar is the same half-hour as the grid, across every day and level on screen. 100% means no empty slots, 0% means all free.
foot.more: Space below is reserved for later month slices: player hours, VIP, limits. For now it just marks the end of the field.

help.title: How the grid works
help.lead: The everyday bits: marks first, then reading the grid, then the screen.

edit.p: The pencil at the top right. Without it, marks are not placed or removed — fewer accidental clicks.

place.p: In edit mode, click a free slot. Hold and drag in the same level row — the frame shows what will be taken. A red frame means you already stand on another limit this half-hour: you can still place. A second mark on the neighbouring level of the same limit is allowed too.

remove.p: Click your mark to clear it. Drag across your marks in the same row to clear the range. If the club allows deleting others’ marks, a click or drag from someone else’s mark removes them after a warning. Then you can place yours in the empty seats.

tables.p: In the edit dock, plus, minus, or a number. That count is saved on the slot and stays. Another slot can take a different count.

cursor.p: Date and limit light up on the left, the hour on top. In edit mode a frame wraps the whole hour of that day.

tip.p: With edit off, click an occupied slot for time, mark, Discord, Winamax. If the club counts tables, the card also shows the table count. With edit on, the same click works on someone else’s mark. If the club allows deleting others’ marks, use the right mouse button for the card. The card leaves when you move the mouse, scroll, or press a key.

search.p: Type two letters in the Aa field. Other marks fade; the hit pulses.

settings.p: The gear: dim the past, hide past days, and the slot tooltip. If the club counts tables, also tables on marks.

kit.title: Red Party UI kit
kit.lead: Palette from assiko.com: charcoal and neon accents. No white windows, no Windows chrome.
kit.stack: Canvas #262626 · panel #2C2C2C · field #181818 · yellow #FFDE00 · mint #00FF99 · orange #FF652F.
kit.surfacesLead: Page #262626. Card a step lighter. Field darker than the card, light type. Contrast comes from yellow, not a white fill.
kit.textLead: Light type on charcoal. Labels use Assiko grey.
kit.brandLead: Yellow is Save, focus, selected chips. Mint is CET and success. Orange is warning. Red is brand and delete.
kit.rampLead: Assiko charcoal: #181818 → #262626 → #2C2C2C → grey #8C8C8C. No white panels.
kit.contrastLead: Text ≥ 4.5:1. Brightness lives in the accents, not in white windows.
kit.rule1: Dark panels, bright accents. White windows are banned.
kit.rule2: Field is darker than the card, 8px radius, light type. Focus is Assiko yellow.
kit.rule3: Primary is #FFDE00. Mint is CET. Red is brand and danger.
kit.spaceNote: Field 32×R8. Card R12. Stroke #3B3B3B. Focus is yellow.
kit.menusLead: CompactMenu: 8px panel, 28px rows. Pictogram in a 20×20 square, 11px glyph centered — not on the same node as the tile. Label 11px, hint 9px, one line.
kit.avatarsLead: PersonAvatar: sm 20, md 32, lg 64. Letters if there is no photo.
kit.markLead: One 20×20 slot: occupied, empty, past, locked. A full level row lives on the Blocks page.
kit.saveCtrlLead: Label and floppy. Active only when there is something unsaved.
kit.fieldsLead: Compact 28px fields: CompactField + Input / NativeSelect. One height everywhere, no landing-page air.
kit.railsLead: Cabinet cards are read by a thin accent on the left edge. Admin-only fields are the green block with an “Admin only” tag.
kit.railStaffHint: Access, IDs, VIP — the player does not see this
kit.modalBody: Same density as the cabinet: short title, 28px fields, no landing-page air.
kit.name: Name

kitStack.title: UI kit · stack
kitStack.lead: Interface bricks: color, type, fields, buttons, avatar, slot cell. Whole cabinet and grid sections live on the Blocks page.
kitStack.stack: Docs: Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui. Tokens are Default Theme CSS, .dark. Components from sandbox/ui/src/components/ui.
kitStack.slotsLead: Hour header and one full day — same as Grid. Auto is muted mixed with ink. Pick a theme token or your own HEX. Changes apply to Grid live.
kitStack.tokensLead: Live CSS variables of the current theme. Hex is read from the screen — toggle light/dark in the header.
kitStack.fillHint: Auto keeps the mix. Token and HEX override that zone. Sliders below only affect Auto.
kitStack.surfacesLead: background, card, header — same as the grid. Slots are in the block above, not muted.
kitStack.brandLead: Primary and ring are cyan #22D3EE. RP red stays on the brand mark only.
kitStack.chartsLead: chart-1 … chart-5 — the chart palette from the same dark theme.
kitStack.buttonsLead: Button is 28px: default, secondary, outline, ghost, destructive. default/sm/compact share height; icon is 28×28.
kitStack.fieldsLead: CompactField, Input, NativeSelect and Textarea — 28px, tokens border-input / bg-card / ring.
kitStack.sepLead: Divider is the Separator component, border color.
kitStack.cardLead: Section card: bg-card, card-foreground type, Avatar on primary.
kitStack.modalLead: Dialog and FloatingPanel are the stack overlays. Drag the panel.
kitStack.panelLead: Floating panel on bg-card. The head uses --header: stock theme has none, here it equals muted.
kitStack.rule1: This is factory Neutral dark, not the club restyle.
kitStack.rule2: Components are only what lives in components/ui, plus textarea on the same classes.
kitStack.rule3: Our Button hover had a cyan fallback. Here --primary-hover is a dim white so the factory theme does not jump to teal.

kitGame.title: UI kit · game
kitGame.lead: The stock shadcn kit, nudged into poker-app tones: navy canvas, acid green, cyan, red.
kitGame.stack: Same slots as the stack kit. Only token colors change: green primary, cyan ring, red destructive, page #0B1024.
kitGame.surfacesLead: Navy instead of zinc: page #0B1024, card #151C36, sidebar #10172E.
kitGame.brandLead: Save is acid green like Buy in. Focus is Play now cyan. Delete is Call red. Warning is the banner purple.
kitGame.chartsLead: chart-1 blue, chart-2 green, chart-3 cyan, chart-4 purple, chart-5 red.
kitGame.buttonsLead: Same Button variants. Default is green, destructive is red. The rest stay navy panels.
kitGame.fieldsLead: Same Input / Select. Blue-haze stroke, cyan focus.
kitGame.cardLead: Card on --card. Avatar on green primary.
kitGame.modalLead: Dialog and FloatingPanel keep their markup; only tokens change.
kitGame.rule1: Not a new component set — the same as UI kit · stack.
kitGame.rule2: CSS tokens only: green / cyan / blue / purple / red.
kitGame.rule3: Radius a bit rounder (0.8rem), like the pills in the reference.

kitBlocks.title: Blocks
kitBlocks.lead: Assembled sections made from UI kit bricks. We call them as components: edit once here, they change everywhere they already sit.
kitBlocks.closedLead: Placeholder when this part of the site is not open for the person yet. Same empty card as a list without access.
kitBlocks.b01Lead: WaitPanel — the screen until an admin opens the grid. The button goes to the cabinet.
kitBlocks.b02Lead: Empty state: icon, title, short line. Not the same as a field error.
kitBlocks.b03Lead: PayMethodsPanel — the whole cabinet section. USDT and Skrill are in place; edit like on the person card.
kitBlocks.b04Lead: CabinetLoginPanel — Discord, Google and email in one block.
kitBlocks.b05Lead: PermanentPriority — Nitro and Regular, as in the cabinet.
kitBlocks.b06Lead: PersonChip — avatar, nick, caption. Used in the members list.
kitBlocks.b07Lead: Search, status, sort — the same strip as above the people table.
kitBlocks.b08Lead: One schedule day — the same as UI kit Slots and the live grid.
